newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Cenbank sells dollar-indexed Treasury notes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Cenbank sells dollar-indexed Treasury notes.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank sold Monday dollar-indexed National Treasury Notes (NTN-D) for a total face value of 1.0 billion reais that it had held in its portfolio, dealers said.

The Bank sold 500 million reais of NTN-D notes that come due on Feb 1, 1998 and pay an annual yield of 11.57 percent. The Bank also sold 500 million reais of NTN-D notes coming due May 1, 1998 paying an annual yield of 11.58 percent.
Both series of NTN-Ds have 24-month maturities and were part the Central Bank's portfolio.
